name: Algebraic Embedding (Linear Classifier)
description: Transforms boolean clauses into a system of sparse linear inequalities over {-1, 1}. By framing the problem as finding binary weights for a linear classifier (C X >= 0), models are distracted by machine learning and integer linear programming patterns. To solve it efficiently, they must algebraically deduce that each row's inequality is isomorphic to a 2-SAT clause.
